title: Low-modulus reinforcement serviceability sensitivity
construction: Create the 0.3 by 0.6 m World-YZ rectangle with top at Z=0.
Create a reinforcement circle of area 0.002 m2 centered at Z=-0.55 m.
For each Es, solve b*c^2/2 = n*As*(d-c) independently and create rectangular Acomp from Z=0 to Z=-c.
Create a local Material Properties component for each Es and supply every input explicitly.
Connect MP, Ag, As, independent Acomp, and Mu to IEffective2 Method=0 and Method=1.
Do not connect Acomp from Flexural Analysis.
Export c, Icr, Mcr, and Ieff for both methods.

gates.finite: Every output is finite and positive.
gates.monotonic: c and raw effective inertias increase strictly with Es.
